mapper.select: SELECT pblib_id, rdrm_id, pblib_nm, lclgv_nm, rdrm_nm, now_vstr_cnt, tseat_cnt, use_seat_cnt, rsvt_seat_cnt, rmnd_seat_cnt, updated_at FROM seat_current_room WHERE pblib_id = #{key.pblibId} AND rdrm_id = #{key.rdrmId}

SELECT pblib_id AS pblibId, rdrm_id AS rdrmId, pblib_nm AS pblibNm, lclgv_nm AS lclgvNm, rdrm_nm AS rdrmNm, now_vstr_cnt AS nowVstrCnt, tseat_cnt AS tseatCnt, use_seat_cnt AS useSeatCnt, rsvt_seat_cnt AS rsvtSeatCnt, rmnd_seat_cnt AS rmndSeatCnt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM seat_current_room
AND name_norm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cond.name}, '%')
AND region_norm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cond.region}, '%')
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT #{cond.limit} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
LIMIT 50
